title: SNAPSHOT — composing address and project-price snapshots
summary: Explore of the SNAPSHOT handler inside the Ingress container: snapshot requests are turned into CustomerAddress and ProjectWithPrice snapshots read from persisted ingress models and published to the domain queue for Functions DOMAIN. Arrows explain responsibilities, never execution order or observed events.
